author: claude
statement: V(n) is exact for every n from 1 to 94, each value by a lower-bound certificate and a colouring that attains it, using nothing else; beyond TABLE92: V(93) = 416, V(94) = 425.
quote: Two more exact values: V(93) = 416 and V(94) = 425, each equal to A(n), by certificates of 2,336 and 2,094 cubes
